task.title: P6-166: Stop /my from blocking on and shipping the hidden all_cards table on phones
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-166. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**A phone's bare `/my` still blocks under `SsrMode::Async` on the `all_cards` aggregate read and ships the full hidden table (~50 `<tr>`s) that is never displayed at that width** (was `P6-021b`; `lib.rs:130`, `all_cards.rs:148`). Unchanged from before, but the CSS switch is what makes it pure waste, and skipping it needs a client hint or two documents since width is unknowable at SSR.
